types.name: AccessKey
types.description: An access key for CI/CD integrations. Unlike personal API keys, access keys are not tied to a specific user's permissions but are scoped to an organization with specific capabilities and resource access (e.g., specific release pipelines). They support revocation with a grace period, allowing existing deployments to complete before the key becomes fully invalid.

fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The user who created the access key.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: lastUsedAt
fields.description: The timestamp when the access key was last used to authenticate an API request. Null if the key has never been used.

fields.name: organization
fields.description: The organization this access key belongs to.

fields.name: revokedAt
fields.description: The timestamp when the access key was revoked. May be set to a future date to implement a grace period during which the key remains valid. Null if the key has not been revoked.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

Built-in AI and workflow actions can use the shared Linear actor rather than a separate user account.

fields.name: avatarUrl

fields.name: id

fields.name: subType

fields.name: userDisplayName

types.name: AgentActivity
types.description: One message or action in an agent session. Use activities to show what your agent is doing and to read messages from users. The content type distinguishes progress updates, tool actions, responses, errors, and requests for input; a signal can modify how Linear handles that content. Access to an activity follows access to its session.

fields.name: agentSession
fields.description: The agent session this activity belongs to.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The message or action recorded by this activity. This is a GraphQL union: request __typename and use inline fragments to select the fields for each content type. Thought, response, prompt, error, and elicitation content have a body; action content describes the action, its parameter, and any reported result.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: ephemeral
fields.description: Whether this progress activity should stop being displayed after the next agent activity arrives. Use this for temporary thoughts or actions, such as a current search step. It does not mean the activity is deleted from the API.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: promptAuthor
fields.description: The user who sent this prompt, including stop requests. Null for other activity types or if the user is not accessible.

fields.name: signal
fields.description: How Linear or the agent should handle this activity beyond its content type. continue keeps a response from ending the turn; auth and select turn an elicitation into an authentication or selection request; stop appears on user prompts that request cancellation. Null means normal handling for the content type.

fields.name: signalMetadata
fields.description: JSON-encoded details for the activity’s signal. auth metadata contains the authentication URL and may identify a provider and user. select metadata contains the available options; Linear may add display labels for recognized URLs. Null means no signal metadata was recorded.

fields.name: sourceComment
fields.description: The source comment this activity is linked to. Null if the activity was not triggered by a comment.

fields.name: sourceMetadata
fields.description: JSON object attributing the activity to the integration, application, or automation that created it. Available properties depend on the source type. Null means no external source was recorded; user identifies the activity's author separately.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

fields.name: user
fields.description: The author: the app user for agent output, or the person who sent a prompt.

fields.name: parameter

fields.name: result

types.name: AgentActivityContent
types.description: The content of one agent activity. Select __typename and use an inline fragment for the returned content type: thought reports progress, action describes work, response addresses the user, prompt comes from the user, error reports failure, and elicitation asks for input. Each variant also carries its AgentActivityType in type.

types.name: AgentActivityCreateInput
types.description: An activity to publish to a session owned by your authenticated agent app. Choose the content type for the step you want to show, and supply signalMetadata when using an auth or select signal. Linear creates user prompt activities itself; this input accepts only agent output.

inputFields.name: agentSessionId
inputFields.description: The UUID of the unarchived session to publish to. The session’s appUser must be the user represented by your agent token; an app cannot publish activities to another agent’s session.

inputFields.name: content
inputFields.description: The activity as a JSON object. Use {type: "thought", body: "Searching the repository"} for progress, response for an answer, error for a failure, or elicitation to ask for input. These types require a Markdown body. An action instead requires action and parameter strings, and may include a Markdown result. body and result each accept up to 250,000 characters. A response normally completes the turn; add signal: continue when more work follows.

inputFields.name: contextualMetadata
inputFields.description: Metadata about user-provided contextual information for this agent activity.

inputFields.name: ephemeral
inputFields.description: Hide this activity after the next activity. Defaults to false; only thought and action activities can be ephemeral.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

inputFields.name: signal
inputFields.description: An optional instruction for handling the content. Use continue only with a response to keep the turn active. Use auth or select only with an elicitation, and provide the matching signalMetadata. stop is reserved for user prompts and cannot be published through agentActivityCreate. Omit this field for normal handling.

inputFields.name: signalMetadata
inputFields.description: Details required by auth and select signals. For auth, provide a valid url, optionally providerName, and optionally a userId UUID identifying who should authenticate. That userId limits the authentication control in Linear, not access to the activity. For select, provide options: an array of 1–100 objects with a nonempty value and optional label, each up to 256 characters. Omit this field for other signals.

types.name: AgentSession
types.description: A record of an agent’s work and its conversation with users. A session belongs to one app user and may be linked to an issue or comment thread. Your agent publishes activities to report progress and results, and can attach external links and a plan. status reflects the latest activity, so the same session can complete a turn, receive more input, and become active again.

fields.name: activities
fields.description: Activities associated with this agent session.

args.name: after
args.description: Returns results after this cursor. Pair with `first` and the previous page's `endCursor` to fetch the next page. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns results before this cursor. Pair with `last` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: filter
args.description: Filter returned agent activities.

args.name: first
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, starting after `after` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither `first` nor `last` is supplied. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: includeArchived
args.description: Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources.

args.name: last
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, ending before `before` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to `createdAt`. Results are newest first with `first` and oldest first with `last`; use the returned `endCursor` as `before` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom `sort` options on fields that support them.

fields.name: appUser
fields.description: The app user that owns and runs this session. Its agent credentials are required to publish activities or update the session’s plan, title, and external links. This is distinct from creator, the human responsible for starting the session.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: The root comment of the session's thread. Null for sessions without a comment thread.

fields.name: context
fields.description: JSON array of entity references supplied as context to the session, such as issues or projects referenced in chat. These provide additional context beyond the session's primary issue or comment. An empty array means no such entity context is recorded.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The human user responsible for the agent session. When a person starts the session, this is that person. When an automation such as a Loop or a triage rule delegates an issue to a third-party agent, this is the issue assignee, on whose behalf the agent works. Null when the session has no responsible human user, such as a session an automation starts for the Linear agent, or a session started by an agent user.

fields.name: dismissedAt
fields.description: The time the session was dismissed. Dismissal stops its work and removes the issue delegate if no other active session needs it. Null if not dismissed.

fields.name: dismissedBy
fields.description: The user who dismissed the agent session. Automatically set when dismissedAt is updated. Null if the session has not been dismissed.

fields.name: endedAt
fields.description: The time the session most recently became complete. Cleared when the status becomes active, pending, or stopping. Null if no completion is recorded or the timestamp has been cleared.

fields.name: externalLink
fields.description: The URL of an external agent-hosted page associated with this session.

fields.name: externalLinks
fields.description: External links associated with this session.

fields.name: externalUrls
fields.description: JSON-encoded array of external links, each with url and label. Parse the returned string to read the entries, or use externalLinks to select these fields directly.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: issue
fields.description: The issue the agent is working on. Null for sessions not associated with an issue.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The agent's current plan as a JSON object with entries and updatedAt. entries contains each step's content and status (pending, inProgress, completed, or canceled); updatedAt is the ISO timestamp when Linear accepted the plan. The owning app updates the entries through agentSessionUpdate. Null means no plan is stored. Entering error or stale status clears the plan.

fields.name: slugId
fields.description: The agent session's unique URL slug.

fields.name: sourceComment
fields.description: The comment in another thread that started this session. Use comment for the session’s own thread. Null means no separate source comment is recorded, or that comment is no longer available.

fields.name: sourceMetadata
fields.description: JSON object describing the integration, application, or automation that created this session. Available keys depend on the source type; agentSessionMetadata.sourceCommentId can identify the comment that converted an existing thread into a session. Null when no source metadata is recorded.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: The time this session most recently became active. A new user turn can make a completed session active again and replace this value, so it is not necessarily the session’s original start time. Null means the session has not started.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current session status: pending, active, stopping, awaitingInput, complete, error, or stale. A completed session can become active again when a new turn starts.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The session title, generated automatically, set by the owning OAuth application, or set by the session's creator. Null if no title is set.

fields.name: type
fields.description: [DEPRECATED] The type of the agent session.
fields.deprecationReason: This field is slated for removal.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL to the agent session page in the Linear app. Null when no issue is associated.

types.name: AuthResolverResponse

fields.name: availableOrganizations

inputFields.description: Collection conditions that must all match. Different some branches can be satisfied by different comments.

inputFields.description: Conditions on the stored comment body text. This filters the comment itself, not its quoted text or replies.

inputFields.description: Requires at least one related comment and requires every related comment to match these conditions. Use length: { eq: 0 } to find an empty collection.

types.name: Customer

fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: domains

fields.name: externalIds
fields.description: Customer identifiers in external systems. Each ID must be unique across customers in the workspace, including archived customers.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: integration
fields.description: The integration that manages this customer's data (e.g., Intercom, Salesforce). Null if the customer is not managed by any data source integration.

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.description: URL of the customer's logo image. Null if no logo has been uploaded.

fields.name: mainSourceId
fields.description: The external ID selected as the primary data source. When set, it must be in externalIds. Null when no primary source has been selected.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The display name of the customer organization.

fields.name: needs
fields.description: The list of customer needs (product requests and feedback) associated with this customer.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The workspace member assigned as the owner of this customer. Null if no owner has been assigned. App users cannot be set as customer owners.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: Annual revenue in whole units of the workspace’s configured revenue currency. Null if not provided; the value remains annual when the UI displays monthly revenue.

fields.name: size
fields.description: The number of employees or seats at the customer organization. Null if size data has not been provided. May be synced from an external data source such as a CRM integration.

fields.name: slackChannelId
fields.description: The ID of the Slack channel linked to this customer for communication. Null if no Slack channel has been associated. Must be unique across all customers in the workspace.

fields.name: tier

fields.name: updatedAt

types.name: CustomerNeed
types.description: A request or piece of feedback associated with a customer and linked to an issue or project. It can include a written message, priority, and an attachment pointing to the original conversation. Multiple needs can connect the same customer to the same work, preserving each source of feedback.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: attachment
fields.description: The issue attachment linked to this need. Populated when the need originates from an intake source (e.g., Slack, Intercom) or when a URL is manually provided. Provides a link back to the original source of the customer feedback. Mutually exclusive with projectAttachment.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Manually supplied feedback in Markdown. Null if no body was set; content also includes feedback extracted from the source attachment.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: An optional comment providing additional context for this need. Null if the need was not created from or associated with a specific comment.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The effective Markdown content shown for this customer need. Returns the manually stored body when present, otherwise falls back to content extracted from the source attachment. Null if no content is available.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: The user recorded as the creator of this customer request. Null if no creator was recorded or the user was deleted.

fields.name: customer
fields.description: The customer organization this need belongs to. Null if the need has not yet been associated with a customer.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: issue
fields.description: The issue linked to this request. Null for requests linked directly to a project or another source.

fields.name: originalIssue
fields.description: The original issue recorded when this request moved during an issue merge. Moving the request explicitly with customerNeedUpdate clears this reference. Null when no original issue is recorded or that issue was deleted.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Whether the customer need is important or not. 0 = Not important, 1 = Important.

fields.name: project
fields.description: The project linked to this request, either directly or through its issue. Null if no project is associated.

fields.name: projectAttachment
fields.description: The project attachment linked to this need. Populated when the need originates from an intake source or when a URL is manually provided for a project-level need. Provides a link back to the original source of the customer feedback. Mutually exclusive with attachment.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL of the source attachment linked to this need, if any. Returns the URL from either the issue attachment or project attachment. Null if the need has no attached source.

types.name: Cycle
types.description: A scheduled period of work for a team. Issues can belong to one cycle at a time, and unfinished work can move into the next cycle when the current one closes. Use the history arrays to track scope and completion over time, and progress for the cycle’s current progress.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: autoArchivedAt
fields.description: Time the cycle was automatically archived. Null if it has not been auto-archived.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: The time the cycle was closed, or null while it is upcoming or active. A cycle can close before its originally scheduled end, for example when the next cycle is started early.

fields.name: completedIssueCountHistory
fields.description: Daily completed issue counts. Entries align with issueCountHistory.

fields.name: completedScopeHistory
fields.description: Daily completed scope, weighted by the team’s estimation settings. Entries align with scopeHistory.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of the cycle’s goals. Null if none is set.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.description: Time the cycle ends. Completing a cycle early moves this time to its completion time.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: inProgressScopeHistory
fields.description: Daily started scope, weighted by the team’s estimation settings. Entries align with scopeHistory.

fields.name: inheritedFrom
fields.description: The parent team’s cycle that this cycle inherits. Null if this cycle is not inherited.

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether the cycle is currently active. A cycle is active if the current time is between its start and end dates and it has not been completed.

fields.name: isFuture
fields.description: Whether the cycle has not yet started. True if the cycle's start date is in the future.

fields.name: isNext
fields.description: Whether this cycle is the next upcoming (not yet started) cycle for the team.

fields.name: isPast
fields.description: Whether the cycle's end date has passed.

fields.name: isPrevious
fields.description: Whether this cycle is the most recently completed cycle for the team.

fields.name: issueCountHistory
fields.description: Daily snapshots of the total number of issues in the cycle, starting with its first day. The corresponding positions in completedIssueCountHistory and the scope histories describe the same days.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Issues that are currently assigned to this cycle.

args.name: after
args.description: Returns results after this cursor. Pair with `first` and the previous page's `endCursor` to fetch the next page. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns results before this cursor. Pair with `last` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: filter
args.description: Filter returned issues.

args.name: first
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, starting after `after` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither `first` nor `last` is supplied. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: includeArchived
args.description: Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources.

args.name: last
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, ending before `before` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to `createdAt`. Results are newest first with `first` and oldest first with `last`; use the returned `endCursor` as `before` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom `sort` options on fields that support them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The custom name of the cycle. If not set, the cycle is displayed using its number (e.g., "Cycle 5").

fields.name: number
fields.description: Automatically assigned cycle number, unique within the team.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: The cycle’s progress from 0 to 1. Completed work contributes fully and started work contributes 25%; triage, canceled, and duplicate issues are excluded. Uses estimates when their total is nonzero and otherwise uses issue counts. Returns 0 for no eligible work, and 0.999 instead of 1 when open issues with zero estimates remain.

fields.name: scopeHistory
fields.description: Daily snapshots of the cycle’s total scope, using the team’s estimation settings. This can change as work is added, removed, or re-estimated; it is not a fixed commitment captured at the start.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.description: The time the cycle starts. Cycle scheduling uses the team’s time zone, so local start times can have different UTC offsets across daylight-saving changes.

fields.name: team
fields.description: The team that owns the cycle.

fields.name: uncompletedIssuesUponClose
fields.description: Issues recorded as unfinished when this cycle closed. These are a snapshot of cycle membership at closure; their current status or cycle may have changed since then.

types.name: DocumentFilter
types.description: Conditions used to select documents. Supplied fields are combined with AND; use `or` to accept alternatives and `and` to group conditions.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: Conditions that the document must all match. These are combined with the other fields in this filter.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days.

inputFields.name: creator
inputFields.description: Conditions on the user who created the document, independent of its current owner.

inputFields.name: cycle
inputFields.description: Conditions on the cycle that contains the document.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: Filters by the resource's stable UUID. Use `eq` for one ID or `in` for a list of IDs.

inputFields.name: initiative
inputFields.description: Conditions on the initiative that contains the document.

inputFields.name: issue
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue that contains the document. This selects attached documents, not the issue’s own description.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description: Alternative conditions; the document must match at least one. Other fields at this level must still match. An empty list adds no condition.

inputFields.name: owner
inputFields.description: Conditions on the document’s owner. Use null: true for documents without an owner; ownership is separate from the creator and most recent editor.

inputFields.name: parentDocument
inputFields.description: Filters that the document's parent document must satisfy. Use `null: true` for documents that are not sub-documents.

inputFields.name: personalUser
inputFields.description: Filters that the user owning the personal space of a personal document must satisfy. Use `null: false` for personal documents.

inputFields.name: project
inputFields.description: Conditions on the project that contains the document. This selects documents directly associated with a project, not documents attached to that project’s issues.

inputFields.name: release
inputFields.description: Conditions on the release that contains the document.

inputFields.name: searchableContent
inputFields.description: Comparator for the document's searchable content.

inputFields.name: slugId
inputFields.description: Conditions on the document’s short URL identifier. This differs from its UUID and title.

inputFields.name: team
inputFields.description: Conditions on the team directly associated with the document. Use null: true when no team is set on the document.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: Conditions on the document title. This does not search the document’s body.

inputFields.name: updatedAt
inputFields.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window.

types.name: DocumentSearchPayload
types.description: A page of document search results. Read nodes for the matched documents and pageInfo to continue paging. totalCount is the size of the limited candidate set, not an exact workspace-wide match count.

fields.name: archivePayload
fields.description: Serialized archived documents on this page and their archived projects, for Linear’s client. For normal API reads, select the document fields you need from nodes instead.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: The page's results paired with their cursors.

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: The resources on this page, in the same order as `edges`. Empty when no results match or no more results remain in the requested direction.

fields.name: pageInfo
fields.description: Cursors and availability of pages before and after this one.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Number of candidates retrieved before filtering and pagination. Search caps candidates, so this is not an exact count of all matching documents.

types.name: DocumentSearchResult
types.description: A document returned by search, with the same fields as Document plus search metadata. The meaning of metadata.score depends on the query’s ordering.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The hex color of the document icon. Null if no custom color has been set.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Comments on the document’s content, including inline discussion threads. Use each comment’s parent, children, and resolution fields to present the discussion.

args.name: after
args.description: Returns results after this cursor. Pair with `first` and the previous page's `endCursor` to fetch the next page. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns results before this cursor. Pair with `last` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: filter
args.description: Filter returned comments.

args.name: first
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, starting after `after` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither `first` nor `last` is supplied. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: includeArchived
args.description: Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources.

args.name: last
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, ending before `before` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to `createdAt`. Results are newest first with `first` and oldest first with `last`; use the returned `endCursor` as `before` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom `sort` options on fields that support them.

fields.name: content

fields.name: hiddenAt

Tracked separately from external users but shaped compatibly so the UI can render teams alongside users in assignment, review, and mention surfaces.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: avatarUrl
fields.description: A URL to the team's avatar image. Null when GitHub does not expose a logo for the team.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable description of the team, when set on GitHub.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: lastSeen
fields.description: The last time the team was observed in a GitHub payload (e.g. requested as a reviewer). Defaults to the creation time and is updated on subsequent sightings.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The GitHub team's display name (e.g. "Frontend Team").

fields.name: organization
fields.description: The workspace that the team was discovered for.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: The GitHub team's slug (e.g. "frontend-team"). Used as the team's at-mention handle, scoped by the GitHub organization that owns the team.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: IDComparator
types.description: Compares resource UUIDs by equality or list membership. All supplied conditions must match. Use `in` to fetch a known set of resources; an empty `in` list matches nothing. Human-readable identifiers are accepted only by the entity-specific ID comparators.

inputFields.name: eq
inputFields.description: Matches the given value.

inputFields.name: in
inputFields.description: Matches any value in the list. An empty list matches nothing.

inputFields.name: neq
inputFields.description: Excludes the given value.

inputFields.name: nin
inputFields.description: Excludes every value in the list. An empty list adds no restriction.

types.name: IdentityProvider
types.description: A SAML/SSO or web forms identity provider configuration for a workspace. Identity providers enable single sign-on authentication via SAML 2.0 and can optionally support SCIM for automated user provisioning and group-based role mapping. Each workspace can have a default general-purpose identity provider and additional web forms identity providers for Asks web authentication.

fields.name: allowNameChange
fields.description: Whether users are allowed to change their name and display name even if SCIM is enabled.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: defaultMigrated
fields.description: Whether the identity provider is the default identity provider migrated from organization level settings.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: issuerEntityId
fields.description: The issuer's custom entity ID.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: The SAML priority used to pick default workspace in SAML SP initiated flow, when same domain is claimed for SAML by multiple workspaces. Lower priority value means higher preference.

fields.name: samlEnabled
fields.description: Whether SAML authentication is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: scimEnabled
fields.description: Whether SCIM provisioning is enabled for the workspace.

fields.name: spEntityId
fields.description: The service provider (Linear) custom entity ID. Defaults to https://auth.linear.app/sso

fields.name: ssoBinding
fields.description: Binding method for authentication call. Can be either `post` (default) or `redirect`.

fields.name: ssoEndpoint
fields.description: Sign in endpoint URL for the identity provider.

fields.name: ssoSignAlgo
fields.description: The algorithm of the Signing Certificate. Can be one of `sha1`, `sha256` (default), or `sha512`.

fields.name: ssoSigningCert
fields.description: X.509 Signing Certificate in string form.

fields.name: ssoVerifiedAt
fields.description: The time at which the current SAML configuration was marked as verified. Null if it has not been verified. Cleared whenever the SAML configuration changes.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of identity provider.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

types.name: Initiative
types.description: A strategic goal supported by projects and, optionally, sub-initiatives. An initiative has its own owner, lifecycle status, target date, and written updates. Linking a project to an initiative does not change the project’s teams or issue workflow.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: The time the initiative entered Completed status. Changing to any other status clears this value. Null when the initiative has no current completion time.

fields.name: createdAt

fields.name: creator

inputFields.name: ancestors
inputFields.description: Conditions on this initiative’s parent initiatives and their ancestors. For example, some: { id: { eq: ID } } finds descendants of the specified initiative.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: All of these collection conditions must match. Each can test a different member of the collection.

inputFields.name: canceledAt
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative canceled at date.

inputFields.name: completedAt
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative completed at date.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days.

inputFields.name: creator
inputFields.description: Filters that the initiative creator must satisfy.

inputFields.name: customIdentifier
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative's custom identifier.

inputFields.name: every
inputFields.description: Filters that needs to be matched by all initiatives.

inputFields.name: health
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative health: onTrack, atRisk, offTrack

inputFields.name: healthWithAge
inputFields.description: The initiative’s health after accounting for the age of its latest update and its reminder schedule. Accepts onTrack, atRisk, offTrack, outdated, or noUpdate.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: Comparator for the identifier.

inputFields.name: initiativeUpdates
inputFields.description: Conditions on updates published directly to this initiative. Updates on sub-initiatives are not included in this collection.

inputFields.name: labels
inputFields.description: Filters that the initiative labels must satisfy.

inputFields.name: leadTeam
inputFields.description: Conditions on the initiative’s own lead team. Use { null: true } to find workspace-level initiatives.

inputFields.name: length
inputFields.description: The number of related objects, before applying some or every. Use { eq: 0 } to find an empty collection.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative name.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description: At least one of these collection conditions must match.

inputFields.name: owner
inputFields.description: Filters that the initiative owner must satisfy.

inputFields.name: priority
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative priority.

inputFields.name: projects
inputFields.description: Conditions on distinct accessible projects linked to this initiative or its sub-initiatives. A project linked through several sub-initiatives is counted once.

inputFields.name: slugId
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative slug ID.

inputFields.name: some
inputFields.description: Filters that needs to be matched by some initiatives.

inputFields.name: startedAt
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative started at date.

inputFields.name: status
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative status: Proposed, Planned, Active, Completed, Canceled

inputFields.name: targetDate
inputFields.description: Comparator for the initiative target date.

inputFields.name: teams
inputFields.description: Conditions on teams contributing through projects or lead-team associations. When team initiatives are available, this also accounts for sub-initiative projects and lead teams in the initiative hierarchy. Use leadTeam to filter only the initiative’s own lead team.

inputFields.name: updatedAt
inputFields.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window.

types.name: IssueCollectionFilter
types.description: Conditions on a collection of issues. Use some to require a matching item, every to check the whole collection, or length to check its size. Direct issue fields act as some only when no and, or, some, every, or length clause is supplied.

inputFields.name: accumulatedStateUpdatedAt
inputFields.description: Comparator for the issue's accumulatedStateUpdatedAt date.

inputFields.name: activity
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's activities must satisfy.

inputFields.name: addedToCycleAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its current cycle. Changing cycles resets this time; removing the cycle clears it.

inputFields.name: addedToCyclePeriod
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its cycle. before includes the cycle’s first 24 hours; during covers the remaining time before closure, and after covers times at or after closure.

inputFields.name: ageTime
inputFields.description: Age (created -> now) comparator, defined if the issue is still open.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: Collection conditions that must all match. Different some branches can be satisfied by different issues.

inputFields.name: archivedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was archived. Also set includeArchived on the query; a filter alone does not include records excluded by the query’s archive setting.

inputFields.name: assignee
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned user. For example, null: true finds unassigned issues, while id: { eq: "user-uuid" } selects one assignee.

inputFields.name: attachments
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s external links. For example, some with a URL or sourceType condition finds issues with at least one matching attachment.

inputFields.name: autoArchivedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically archived. Include archived issues in the query to find them; restoring an issue clears this value.

inputFields.name: autoClosedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. The value is cleared when its status changes.

inputFields.name: canceledAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. The value is cleared when the issue leaves those status types.

inputFields.name: children
inputFields.description: Conditions on direct sub-issues. Use some for a matching child, every for all children, or length to count them. This does not search all descendants recursively.

inputFields.name: comments
inputFields.description: Conditions on comments linked directly to the issue, including replies. Inline comments on the issue description are linked through documentContent and are not included by this filter.

inputFields.name: completedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on the recorded completion time. Use null: false to require a completion time, or a date range to find issues completed during that period.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days.

inputFields.name: creator
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues creator must satisfy.

inputFields.name: customerCount
inputFields.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active requests linked to the issue. Requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerCount conditions in and.

inputFields.name: customerImportantCount
inputFields.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active, important requests linked to the issue. Important requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerImportantCount conditions in and.

inputFields.name: cycle
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned cycle. Use null: true for issues without a cycle or whose team has cycles disabled. Use null: false to require an assigned cycle on a team with cycles enabled. Other cycle comparisons do not require cycles to be enabled.

inputFields.name: cycleTime
inputFields.description: Cycle time (started -> completed) comparator.

inputFields.name: delegate
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's delegated agent must satisfy.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s stored description text. Use null to find issues without a stored description, or text comparisons to match its contents.

inputFields.name: dueDate
inputFields.description: Conditions on the due date, without a time of day. Use null: true for issues without a due date.

inputFields.name: estimate
inputFields.description: Conditions on the stored numeric estimate in the team’s scale. Use null to find unestimated issues; zero is a separate, explicit estimate.

inputFields.name: every
inputFields.description: Requires at least one related issue and requires every related issue to match these conditions. Use length: { eq: 0 } to find an empty collection.

inputFields.name: hasActiveAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having active agent sessions, no closed agent pull requests, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasBlockedByRelations
inputFields.description: Whether another issue blocks this issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

inputFields.name: hasBlockingRelations
inputFields.description: Whether this issue blocks another issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

inputFields.name: hasDismissedAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having all agent sessions dismissed or closed, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasDuplicateRelations
inputFields.description: Whether other issues have been marked as duplicates of this issue. This checks incoming duplicate links, not whether this issue is itself a duplicate.

inputFields.name: hasErroredAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having an errored agent session, no active sessions, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasMergedAgentPullRequests
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have agent-session-linked pull requests that were merged.

inputFields.name: hasRelatedRelations
inputFields.description: Whether the issue has a related link in either direction. Blocking links also count as related when either issue is closed; open blocking relationships are covered by hasBlockingRelations and hasBlockedByRelations.

inputFields.name: hasSharedUsers
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have been shared with users outside of the team.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedAssignees
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested assignees.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedLabels
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested labels.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedProjects
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested projects.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedRelatedIssues
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested related issues.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedSimilarIssues
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested similar issues.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedTeams
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested teams.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: Matches the issue UUID or human-readable identifier, such as ENG-123. Use number with a team filter when matching only the numeric portion.

inputFields.name: labels
inputFields.description: Conditions on assigned labels. Use some for at least one matching label, every to constrain all labels, or length: { eq: 0 } for unlabeled issues. Separate some conditions in and can require different labels on the same issue.

inputFields.name: lastAppliedTemplate
inputFields.description: Filters that the last applied template must satisfy.

inputFields.name: leadTime
inputFields.description: Lead time (created -> completed) comparator.

inputFields.name: length
inputFields.description: Conditions on the total number of related issues, independent of some or every. Use eq: 0 to find an empty collection.

inputFields.name: needs
inputFields.description: Conditions on customer requests linked to the issue. Use some to require a matching request or length to count linked requests.

inputFields.name: number
inputFields.description: Matches the issue number within its team. Numbers are not unique across teams, so combine this with team when looking for a specific issue.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description: Alternative collection conditions; at least one must match. Other collection clauses at this level still apply. An empty list adds no condition.

inputFields.name: parent
inputFields.description: Conditions on the immediate parent issue. Use null: true to find top-level issues, or an ID condition to find direct sub-issues of one parent.

inputFields.name: priority
inputFields.description: Conditions on the numeric priority: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Lower nonzero values mean higher priority.

inputFields.name: project
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned project. Use null: true for issues without a project; otherwise the project must match the supplied conditions.

inputFields.name: projectMilestone
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues project milestone must satisfy.

inputFields.name: reactions
inputFields.description: Conditions on emoji reactions added directly to the issue. Reactions on its comments are filtered through comments.reactions.

inputFields.name: recurringIssueTemplate
inputFields.description: [ALPHA] Filters that the recurring issue template must satisfy.

inputFields.name: releases
inputFields.description: Conditions on releases linked to the issue. An issue can belong to several releases; use some to require a matching release or length to count them.

inputFields.name: searchableContent
inputFields.description: Comparator for the issues content.

inputFields.name: sharedWith
inputFields.description: Filters that users the issue has been shared with must satisfy.

inputFields.name: slaBreachesAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on the SLA deadline. A deadline before now does not by itself mean the SLA was missed; use slaStatus to distinguish unfinished breaches from completed outcomes.

inputFields.name: slaStatus
inputFields.description: Conditions on the current SLA risk or outcome. Use null: true for issues without an SLA status, including canceled issues and issues without an SLA.

inputFields.name: snoozedBy
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues snoozer must satisfy.

inputFields.name: snoozedUntilAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue’s triage snooze ends. Use null: true for issues without a recorded snooze time.

inputFields.name: some
inputFields.description: Requires at least one related issue to match these conditions. An empty collection does not match.

inputFields.name: sourceMetadata
inputFields.description: Filters that the source must satisfy.

inputFields.name: startedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when work started. Use null: true for issues with no recorded start time; moving back to triage, backlog, or an unstarted status clears it.

inputFields.name: state
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s current status. Filter by type, such as started or completed, to match the same workflow category across teams with different status names and IDs.

inputFields.name: subscribers
inputFields.description: Filters that issue subscribers must satisfy.

inputFields.name: suggestions
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's suggestions must satisfy.

inputFields.name: team
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues team must satisfy.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue title. This does not search descriptions or comments.

inputFields.name: triageTime
inputFields.description: Triage time (entered triaged -> triaged) comparator.

inputFields.name: triagedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue last left triage. The value is unset before triage is completed and after re-entering triage.

inputFields.name: updatedAt
inputFields.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window.

inputFields.description: The UUID of the user responsible for the issue. Omit it to use the template’s assignee, if any, or pass null to leave that default unset. Team triage rules can still assign an unassigned issue.

inputFields.name: completedAt
inputFields.description: Completion time for an imported issue. Requires createdAt and a completed status; must be in the past and not before createdAt.

inputFields.name: createAsUser
inputFields.description: Display name credited with creating the issue. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Creation time for imported issues. Must be in the past. Defaults to the current time.

inputFields.name: cycleId
inputFields.description: The UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. When a cycle is supplied without a status, the issue starts in the team’s default unstarted status. Team cycle settings can also assign a cycle automatically when you leave this unset.

inputFields.name: delegateId
inputFields.description: The UUID of an agent user to delegate work to. Delegation can start an agent session on the issue and requires permission to invoke that agent.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: The issue’s description in Markdown. Use it for the context, requirements, and links that do not belong in the title. When creating from a template, a supplied description replaces the template’s description.

inputFields.name: displayIconUrl
inputFields.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

inputFields.name: dueDate
inputFields.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone.

inputFields.name: estimate
inputFields.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64. Linear maps it to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale; use numeric values even for T-shirt sizes. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Omit to use the template’s estimate, if any, or pass null for no estimate.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: The identifier in UUID v4 format. If none is provided, the backend will generate one.

inputFields.name: labelIds
inputFields.description: The UUIDs of labels to apply. Labels must be available to the issue’s team, and a single-select group can contribute at most one label. When using a template, these labels are combined with its labels, with your choice taking precedence within a single-select group.

inputFields.name: lastAppliedTemplateId
inputFields.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Use templateId to apply its values.

inputFields.name: parentId
inputFields.description: The UUID or identifier of an existing parent issue, such as ENG-123. Setting this makes the new issue a sub-issue; the parent can belong to another team if you can access it.

inputFields.name: preserveSortOrderOnCreate
inputFields.description: Keep the supplied sortOrder instead of placing the issue first in its status. Defaults to false.

inputFields.name: priority
inputFields.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

inputFields.name: prioritySortOrder
inputFields.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

inputFields.name: projectId
inputFields.description: UUID or identifier of the project, such as P-LIN-123. The project must include the issue’s team. If omitted for a sub-issue, the parent’s project is used when it includes that team; null leaves the issue without a project.

inputFields.name: projectMilestoneId
inputFields.description: The UUID of a milestone in the project supplied in projectId. A milestone cannot be assigned without its project.

inputFields.name: referenceCommentId
inputFields.description: The UUID of a comment whose issue should be linked to the new issue. If the comment belongs to an issue, Linear creates a related-issue relation between that issue and the new one.

inputFields.name: releaseIds
inputFields.description: The UUIDs of releases to associate with the new issue. Requires release management to be available in the workspace; the releases must exist and be accessible to you.

inputFields.name: slaType
inputFields.description: The SLA day count type for the issue. Whether SLA should be business days only or calendar days (default).

inputFields.name: sortOrder
inputFields.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first. Set preserveSortOrderOnCreate to keep this position.

inputFields.name: sourceCommentId
inputFields.description: The UUID of the comment from which this issue was created. Records the source comment on the issue; use referenceCommentId to also link to the comment’s issue.

inputFields.name: stateId
inputFields.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. Defaults to the team’s initial status, or an unstarted status when cycleId is set.

inputFields.name: subIssueSortOrder
inputFields.description: The position among the parent’s direct sub-issues, with lower values first. Requires parentId. If omitted, the new sub-issue is placed last; conflicting positions are adjusted.

inputFields.name: subscriberIds
inputFields.description: The UUIDs of users to subscribe to issue updates. Linear may also subscribe people involved in the issue, such as its assignee and users mentioned in the description.

inputFields.name: teamId
inputFields.description: UUID of the team that will own the issue.

inputFields.name: templateId
inputFields.description: The UUID of an issue template to use. Linear applies its defaults and creates any sub-issues it defines, returning the root issue. Supplied values override the template’s defaults; labelIds are combined with its labels.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: The title shown in issue lists and at the top of the issue. Required unless templateId is provided; when supplied with a template, it replaces the template’s title.

inputFields.name: useDefaultTemplate
inputFields.description: Whether to apply the team’s default template. Linear selects the member or non-member default based on your team membership; if no matching default is set, creation proceeds without a template. Cannot be combined with templateId.

types.name: IssueEdge
types.description: A result and its pagination cursor.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: An opaque cursor for this result. Pass it unchanged to `before` or `after`.

fields.name: node
fields.description: The resource at this position in the result list.

types.name: IssueEmojiReactionNotificationType
types.description: An issue emoji reaction notification type.

types.name: IssueEmojiReactionNotificationWebhookPayload
types.description: Payload for an issue emoji reaction notification.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: The actor who caused the notification.

fields.name: actorId
fields.description: The ID of the actor who caused the notification.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: The time at which the entity was archived.

fields.name: createdAt

fields.name: externalUserActorId
fields.description: The ID of the external user who caused the notification.

fields.name: issue

fields.name: reactionEmoji
fields.description: The emoji of the reaction this notification is for.

fields.name: updatedAt

fields.name: userId
