types.name: IssueFilter
types.description: Conditions used to select issues. Supplied fields are combined with AND; use `or` to accept alternatives and `and` to group conditions.

inputFields.name: accumulatedStateUpdatedAt
inputFields.description: Comparator for the issue's accumulatedStateUpdatedAt date.

inputFields.name: activity
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's activities must satisfy.

inputFields.name: addedToCycleAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its current cycle. Changing cycles resets this time; removing the cycle clears it.

inputFields.name: addedToCyclePeriod
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue joined its cycle. before includes the cycle’s first 24 hours; during covers the remaining time before closure, and after covers times at or after closure.

inputFields.name: ageTime
inputFields.description: Age (created -> now) comparator, defined if the issue is still open.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: Conditions that the issue must all match. These are combined with the other fields in this filter.

inputFields.name: archivedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was archived. Also set includeArchived on the query; a filter alone does not include records excluded by the query’s archive setting.

inputFields.name: assignee
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned user. For example, null: true finds unassigned issues, while id: { eq: "user-uuid" } selects one assignee.

inputFields.name: attachments
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s external links. For example, some with a URL or sourceType condition finds issues with at least one matching attachment.

inputFields.name: autoArchivedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically archived. Include archived issues in the query to find them; restoring an issue clears this value.

inputFields.name: autoClosedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. The value is cleared when its status changes.

inputFields.name: canceledAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. The value is cleared when the issue leaves those status types.

inputFields.name: children
inputFields.description: Conditions on direct sub-issues. Use some for a matching child, every for all children, or length to count them. This does not search all descendants recursively.

inputFields.name: comments
inputFields.description: Conditions on comments linked directly to the issue, including replies. Inline comments on the issue description are linked through documentContent and are not included by this filter.

inputFields.name: completedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on the recorded completion time. Use null: false to require a completion time, or a date range to find issues completed during that period.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days.

inputFields.name: creator
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues creator must satisfy.

inputFields.name: customerCount
inputFields.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active requests linked to the issue. Requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerCount conditions in and.

inputFields.name: customerImportantCount
inputFields.description: Conditions on the number of distinct customers with active, important requests linked to the issue. Important requests without a customer record each count separately. Supply one comparison; to apply a range, put separate customerImportantCount conditions in and.

inputFields.name: cycle
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned cycle. Use null: true for issues without a cycle or whose team has cycles disabled. Use null: false to require an assigned cycle on a team with cycles enabled. Other cycle comparisons do not require cycles to be enabled.

inputFields.name: cycleTime
inputFields.description: Cycle time (started -> completed) comparator.

inputFields.name: delegate
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's delegated agent must satisfy.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s stored description text. Use null to find issues without a stored description, or text comparisons to match its contents.

inputFields.name: dueDate
inputFields.description: Conditions on the due date, without a time of day. Use null: true for issues without a due date.

inputFields.name: estimate
inputFields.description: Conditions on the stored numeric estimate in the team’s scale. Use null to find unestimated issues; zero is a separate, explicit estimate.

inputFields.name: hasActiveAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having active agent sessions, no closed agent pull requests, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasBlockedByRelations
inputFields.description: Whether another issue blocks this issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

inputFields.name: hasBlockingRelations
inputFields.description: Whether this issue blocks another issue, with both issues still open. A link with a closed issue counts under hasRelatedRelations instead.

inputFields.name: hasDismissedAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having all agent sessions dismissed or closed, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasDuplicateRelations
inputFields.description: Whether other issues have been marked as duplicates of this issue. This checks incoming duplicate links, not whether this issue is itself a duplicate.

inputFields.name: hasErroredAgentSessions
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues bucketed as having an errored agent session, no active sessions, and no merged agent pull requests.

inputFields.name: hasMergedAgentPullRequests
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have agent-session-linked pull requests that were merged.

inputFields.name: hasRelatedRelations
inputFields.description: Whether the issue has a related link in either direction. Blocking links also count as related when either issue is closed; open blocking relationships are covered by hasBlockingRelations and hasBlockedByRelations.

inputFields.name: hasSharedUsers
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have been shared with users outside of the team.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedAssignees
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested assignees.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedLabels
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested labels.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedProjects
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested projects.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedRelatedIssues
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested related issues.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedSimilarIssues
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested similar issues.

inputFields.name: hasSuggestedTeams
inputFields.description: Comparator for filtering issues which have suggested teams.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: Matches the issue UUID or human-readable identifier, such as ENG-123. Use number with a team filter when matching only the numeric portion.

inputFields.name: labels
inputFields.description: Conditions on assigned labels. Use some for at least one matching label, every to constrain all labels, or length: { eq: 0 } for unlabeled issues. Separate some conditions in and can require different labels on the same issue.

inputFields.name: lastAppliedTemplate
inputFields.description: Filters that the last applied template must satisfy.

inputFields.name: leadTime
inputFields.description: Lead time (created -> completed) comparator.

inputFields.name: needs
inputFields.description: Conditions on customer requests linked to the issue. Use some to require a matching request or length to count linked requests.

inputFields.name: number
inputFields.description: Matches the issue number within its team. Numbers are not unique across teams, so combine this with team when looking for a specific issue.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description: Alternative conditions; the issue must match at least one. Other fields at this level must still match. An empty list adds no condition.

inputFields.name: parent
inputFields.description: Conditions on the immediate parent issue. Use null: true to find top-level issues, or an ID condition to find direct sub-issues of one parent.

inputFields.name: priority
inputFields.description: Conditions on the numeric priority: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Lower nonzero values mean higher priority.

inputFields.name: project
inputFields.description: Conditions on the assigned project. Use null: true for issues without a project; otherwise the project must match the supplied conditions.

inputFields.name: projectMilestone
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues project milestone must satisfy.

inputFields.name: reactions
inputFields.description: Conditions on emoji reactions added directly to the issue. Reactions on its comments are filtered through comments.reactions.

inputFields.name: recurringIssueTemplate
inputFields.description: [ALPHA] Filters that the recurring issue template must satisfy.

inputFields.name: releases
inputFields.description: Conditions on releases linked to the issue. An issue can belong to several releases; use some to require a matching release or length to count them.

inputFields.name: searchableContent
inputFields.description: Comparator for the issues content.

inputFields.name: sharedWith
inputFields.description: Filters that users the issue has been shared with must satisfy.

inputFields.name: slaBreachesAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on the SLA deadline. A deadline before now does not by itself mean the SLA was missed; use slaStatus to distinguish unfinished breaches from completed outcomes.

inputFields.name: slaStatus
inputFields.description: Conditions on the current SLA risk or outcome. Use null: true for issues without an SLA status, including canceled issues and issues without an SLA.

inputFields.name: snoozedBy
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues snoozer must satisfy.

inputFields.name: snoozedUntilAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue’s triage snooze ends. Use null: true for issues without a recorded snooze time.

inputFields.name: sourceMetadata
inputFields.description: Filters that the source must satisfy.

inputFields.name: startedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when work started. Use null: true for issues with no recorded start time; moving back to triage, backlog, or an unstarted status clears it.

inputFields.name: state
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue’s current status. Filter by type, such as started or completed, to match the same workflow category across teams with different status names and IDs.

inputFields.name: subscribers
inputFields.description: Filters that issue subscribers must satisfy.

inputFields.name: suggestions
inputFields.description: Filters that the issue's suggestions must satisfy.

inputFields.name: team
inputFields.description: Filters that the issues team must satisfy.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: Conditions on the issue title. This does not search descriptions or comments.

inputFields.name: triageTime
inputFields.description: Triage time (entered triaged -> triaged) comparator.

inputFields.name: triagedAt
inputFields.description: Conditions on when the issue last left triage. The value is unset before triage is completed and after re-entering triage.

inputFields.name: updatedAt
inputFields.description: Filters by the last meaningful update time. Some background changes do not advance it. Use `gte` and `lt` together to select a time window.

types.name: IssueFilterSuggestionPayload
types.description: Suggested issue-view filters generated from a natural-language prompt. A suggestion can be absent when the prompt does not produce a filter.

fields.name: filter
fields.description: The suggested filter configuration as JSON. Null if no filter was generated; inspect the suggestion before using it to change a saved view.

fields.name: logId
fields.description: The identifier of the prompt execution that generated the suggestion. Null if no execution identifier is returned.

types.name: IssueHistory
types.description: A recorded change to an issue. Nearby changes can be grouped into one entry, and each from/to pair describes the previous and new value of a changed property. These entries are not full issue snapshots: null can mean the property did not change or that one side of a change was unset. Related records may also be unavailable after deletion.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: The user who made the change. Null for some automated or integration changes, or if the user was deleted.

fields.name: actorId
fields.description: UUID of the user who made the change. Null for some automated or integration changes.

fields.name: actors
fields.description: Users recorded as actors for this entry. Can be null or empty for automated or integration changes, or when the recorded users are no longer available.

fields.name: addedLabelIds
fields.description: The UUIDs of labels added by this entry. This is the change in labels, not the issue’s complete label set.

fields.name: addedLabels
fields.description: The label records added by this change. Deleted or inaccessible labels may be absent; addedLabelIds preserves the recorded identifiers.

fields.name: addedToReleaseIds
fields.description: UUIDs of releases the issue was added to.

fields.name: addedToReleases
fields.description: The releases that the issue was added to.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: Whether the issue was archived (true) or unarchived (false) in this change. Null if the archive status was not changed.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: attachment
fields.description: The attachment associated with this history entry, if it still exists and you can access it. Null when no attachment is recorded or the recorded attachment was removed.

fields.name: attachmentId
fields.description: Identifier of the attachment that was linked to or unlinked from the issue. Can be used to query the attachment directly. Null if no attachment change occurred.

fields.name: autoArchived
fields.description: Whether the issue was auto-archived.

fields.name: autoClosed
fields.description: Whether the issue was auto-closed.

fields.name: botActor
fields.description: The bot that performed the action.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The resource’s recorded creation time, in UTC. Imports may preserve an earlier creation time.

fields.name: customerNeedId
fields.description: [Deprecated] Legacy UUID of a customer request linked to the issue. Not populated for new changes.

fields.name: descriptionUpdatedBy
fields.description: Users whose description edits contributed to this grouped history entry. Null when no description editors are recorded; deleted or inaccessible users may be absent from the result.

fields.name: fromAssignee
fields.description: The assignee before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromAssigneeId
fields.description: Identifier of the user from whom the issue was re-assigned. Can be used to query the user directly. Null if the assignee was not changed or the issue was previously unassigned.

fields.name: fromCycle
fields.description: The cycle before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromCycleId
fields.description: Identifier of the previous cycle of the issue. Can be used to query the cycle directly. Null if the cycle was not changed or the issue was not in a cycle.

fields.name: fromDelegate
fields.description: The agent delegate before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromDueDate
fields.description: The due date before this change, as YYYY-MM-DD without a time or time zone. Null if there was no due date or this entry does not record a due-date change.

fields.name: fromEstimate
fields.description: The estimate before this change, using the team’s numeric estimation scale. Null if no estimate was set or this entry does not record an estimate change.

fields.name: fromParent
fields.description: The parent issue before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromParentId
fields.description: Identifier of the previous parent issue. Can be used to query the issue directly. Null if the parent was not changed or the issue previously had no parent.

fields.name: fromPriority
fields.description: The priority before this change: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Null if this entry does not record a priority change.

fields.name: fromProject
fields.description: The project before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromProjectId
fields.description: Identifier of the previous project of the issue. Can be used to query the project directly. Null if the project was not changed or the issue was not in a project.

fields.name: fromProjectMilestone
fields.description: The project milestone before this change. Null when none was set, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromSlaBreached
fields.description: Whether the issue had previously breached its SLA.

fields.name: fromSlaBreachesAt
fields.description: The SLA breach time that was previously set on the issue.

fields.name: fromSlaStartedAt
fields.description: The time at which the issue's SLA was previously started.

fields.name: fromSlaType
fields.description: Previous SLA day-counting mode: all for calendar days or onlyBusinessDays for working days.

fields.name: fromState
fields.description: The issue status before this change. Null if this entry does not record that change or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromStateId
fields.description: Identifier of the previous workflow state (issue status) of the issue. Can be used to query the workflow state directly. Null if the status was not changed.

fields.name: fromTeam
fields.description: The team before this change. Null if this entry does not record that change or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: fromTeamId
fields.description: Identifier of the team from which the issue was moved. Can be used to query the team directly. Null if the team was not changed.

fields.name: fromTitle
fields.description: What the title was changed from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The resource's unique UUID. This stays unchanged when the resource is renamed or moved; use it for stored references and mutations.

fields.name: issue
fields.description: The issue that was changed.

fields.name: issueImport
fields.description: The import that produced this history entry, when available. Null for changes without an import record or when that record is no longer accessible.

fields.name: relationChanges
fields.description: Changed issue relationships.

fields.name: removedFromReleaseIds
fields.description: UUIDs of releases the issue was removed from.

fields.name: removedFromReleases
fields.description: The releases that the issue was removed from.

fields.name: removedLabelIds
fields.description: The UUIDs of labels removed by this entry. The corresponding label records may no longer be available if they were deleted.

fields.name: removedLabels
fields.description: The label records removed by this change, where they are still available. Use removedLabelIds if you need the recorded identifiers even after a label is deleted.

fields.name: toAssignee
fields.description: The assignee after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toAssigneeId
fields.description: Identifier of the user to whom the issue was assigned. Can be used to query the user directly. Null if the assignee was not changed or the issue was unassigned.

fields.name: toConvertedProject
fields.description: The new project created from the issue.

fields.name: toConvertedProjectId
fields.description: Identifier of the new project that was created by converting this issue to a project. Can be used to query the project directly. Null if the issue was not converted to a project.

fields.name: toCycle
fields.description: The cycle after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toCycleId
fields.description: Identifier of the new cycle of the issue. Can be used to query the cycle directly. Null if the cycle was not changed or the issue was removed from a cycle.

fields.name: toDelegate
fields.description: The agent delegate after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toDueDate
fields.description: The due date after this change, as YYYY-MM-DD without a time or time zone. Null if the date was cleared or this entry does not record a due-date change.

fields.name: toEstimate
fields.description: The estimate after this change, using the team’s numeric estimation scale. Null if the estimate was cleared or this entry does not record an estimate change.

fields.name: toParent
fields.description: The parent issue after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toParentId
fields.description: Identifier of the new parent issue. Can be used to query the issue directly. Null if the parent was not changed or the issue was removed from its parent.

fields.name: toPriority
fields.description: The priority after this change: 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low. Null if this entry does not record a priority change.

fields.name: toProject
fields.description: The project after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toProjectId
fields.description: Identifier of the new project of the issue. Can be used to query the project directly. Null if the project was not changed or the issue was removed from a project.

fields.name: toProjectMilestone
fields.description: The project milestone after this change. Null when the assignment was cleared, the property did not change, or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toSlaBreached
fields.description: Whether the issue has now breached its SLA.

fields.name: toSlaBreachesAt
fields.description: The SLA breach time that is now set on the issue.

fields.name: toSlaStartedAt
fields.description: The time at which the issue's SLA is now started.

fields.name: toSlaType
fields.description: New SLA day-counting mode: all for calendar days or onlyBusinessDays for working days.

fields.name: toState
fields.description: The issue status after this change. Null if this entry does not record that change or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toStateId
fields.description: Identifier of the new workflow state (issue status) of the issue. Can be used to query the workflow state directly. Null if the status was not changed.

fields.name: toTeam
fields.description: The team after this change. Null if this entry does not record that change or the recorded resource is no longer available to you.

fields.name: toTeamId
fields.description: Identifier of the team to which the issue was moved. Can be used to query the team directly. Null if the team was not changed.

fields.name: toTitle
fields.description: What the title was changed to.

fields.name: trashed
fields.description: True if the issue was moved to trash, false if restored, or null if trash status did not change.

fields.name: triageResponsibilityAutoAssigned
fields.description: Whether triage responsibility assigned the issue automatically.

fields.name: triageResponsibilityNotifiedUsers
fields.description: The users that were notified of the issue.

fields.name: triageResponsibilityTeam
fields.description: The team that triggered the triage responsibility action.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: When the resource was last meaningfully updated, in UTC. Some background or housekeeping changes do not advance this timestamp.

fields.name: updatedDescription
fields.description: Whether the description changed in this history entry. The entry records that an edit occurred; it does not contain the old or new Markdown body.

types.name: IssueHistoryConnection
types.description: A page of results. Read `nodes` for the resources, or `edges` if you also need a cursor for each result. Use `pageInfo` to fetch further pages; a connection may contain fewer results than the requested page size.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: The page's results paired with their cursors.

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: The resources on this page, in the same order as `edges`. Empty when no results match or no more results remain in the requested direction.

types.name: IssueLabelCollectionFilter
types.description: Conditions on a collection of labels. Use some to require a matching item, every to check the whole collection, or length to check its size. Direct label fields act as some only when no and, or, some, every, or length clause is supplied.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: Collection conditions that must all match. Different some branches can be satisfied by different labels.

inputFields.name: createdAt
inputFields.description: Filters by creation time. Use a fixed timestamp or a relative duration, such as `{ gte: "-P7D" }` for resources created in the last seven days.

inputFields.name: creator
inputFields.description: Conditions on the user who created the label. Use null: true for labels without a recorded creator.

inputFields.name: every
inputFields.description: Requires all assigned labels to match these conditions. A filter made only of exclusions, such as id.nin, also matches an empty label list; a positive condition normally requires labels. Use length to make any nonempty requirement explicit.

inputFields.name: id
inputFields.description: Filters by the resource's stable UUID. Use `eq` for one ID or `in` for a list of IDs.

inputFields.name: isGroup
inputFields.description: Whether the label is a group rather than an assignable child or standalone label. Group records organize their child labels and define the selection mode.

inputFields.name: length
inputFields.description: Conditions on the total number of related labels, independent of some or every. Use eq: 0 to find an empty collection.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: Conditions on the label or label-group name.

inputFields.name: null
inputFields.description: Tests whether the stored label-ID list is null. An empty list is not null; use length: { eq: 0 } to find issues without labels.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description: Alternative collection conditions; at least one must match. Other collection clauses at this level still apply. An empty list adds no condition.

inputFields.name: parent
inputFields.description: Conditions on the label group that contains this label. For example, parent: { id: { eq: "group-uuid" } } selects the group’s child labels.

inputFields.name: some
inputFields.description: Matches at least one assigned label against these conditions. A filter made only of exclusions, such as id.nin, also matches an empty label list. Add length: { gt: 0 } when a label must be present.

inputFields.name: team
inputFields.description: Conditions on the team that owns the label. Use null: true for workspace labels, or a team ID to find labels scoped to that team.

inputFields.name: updatedAt

fields.name: node
fields.description: The resource at this position in the result list.

types.name: IssueRelationHistoryPayload
types.description: A relation change and the identifier of the other issue.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: The human-readable identifier of the related issue (e.g., ENG-123).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Relation change code: ax/rx adds/removes an issue blocked by this issue; ab/rb adds/removes a blocker; ar/rr adds/removes a related issue; ad/rd marks/unmarks this issue as a duplicate; am/rm adds/removes a duplicate of this issue. br/bo means a blocker was resolved/reopened; xr/xo means this issue was resolved/reopened while blocking the other issue.

types.name: IssueRelationPayload
types.description: The issue relation created, updated, or reused by a mutation.

fields.name: issueRelation
fields.description: The issue relation that was created or updated.

fields.name: lastSyncId
fields.description: Synchronization cursor used by Linear clients. External integrations can ignore this field.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Whether the operation was successful.

types.name: IssueRelationType
types.description: The type of the issue relation.

types.name: IssueRelationUpdateInput
types.description: Changes to an existing relation’s type or either end. Omit fields you want to keep. The resulting source and target must be distinct, and changing a duplicate relation can undo or trigger duplicate-merge behavior.

inputFields.name: issueId
inputFields.description: The identifier of the issue that is related to another issue. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

inputFields.name: relatedIssueId
inputFields.description: The identifier of the related issue. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

inputFields.name: type
inputFields.description: Relation type: blocks, duplicate, related, or the deprecated similar. Omit to keep the current type.

types.name: IssueSearchPayload
types.description: A page of issue search results. Read nodes for the matched issues and pageInfo to continue paging. totalCount describes the retrieved candidate set and can be larger than the results remaining after an issue filter is applied.

fields.name: archivePayload
fields.description: Serialized archived issues on this page and related archived records needed by Linear’s client. For normal API reads, select the issue fields you need from nodes instead.

fields.name: edges
fields.description: The page's results paired with their cursors.

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: The resources on this page, in the same order as `edges`. Empty when no results match or no more results remain in the requested direction.

fields.name: pageInfo
fields.description: Cursors and availability of pages before and after this one.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Number of candidates retrieved before filtering and pagination. Search caps candidates, so this is not an exact count of all matching issues.

types.name: IssueSearchResult
types.description: An issue returned by search, with the same fields as Issue plus search metadata. The meaning of metadata.score depends on the query’s ordering.

fields.name: addedToCycleAt
fields.description: The time the issue was added to its current cycle. Changes when the cycle changes, and is null when the issue has no cycle.

fields.name: addedToProjectAt
fields.description: The time the issue was added to its current project. Changes when the project changes, and is null when the issue has no project.

fields.name: addedToTeamAt
fields.description: The time the issue was created in or moved to its current team. Use this to distinguish a team move from the issue’s original creation time.

fields.name: archivedAt
fields.description: When the resource was archived, in UTC. Null while active, including after unarchiving. Archived resources still exist but are normally excluded from lists unless `includeArchived` is true.

fields.name: asksExternalUserRequester
fields.description: The external user who requested creation of the Asks issue on behalf of the creator.

fields.name: asksRequester
fields.description: The internal user who requested creation of the Asks issue on behalf of the creator.

fields.name: assignee
fields.description: The user to whom the issue is assigned. Null if the issue is unassigned.

fields.name: attachments
fields.description: Attachments associated with the issue.

args.name: after
args.description: Returns results after this cursor. Pair with `first` and the previous page's `endCursor` to fetch the next page. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns results before this cursor. Pair with `last` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: filter
args.description: Filter returned attachments.

args.name: first
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, starting after `after` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither `first` nor `last` is supplied. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: includeArchived
args.description: Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources.

args.name: last
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, ending before `before` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to `createdAt`. Results are newest first with `first` and oldest first with `last`; use the returned `endCursor` as `before` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom `sort` options on fields that support them.

fields.name: autoArchivedAt
fields.description: The time the issue was automatically archived under the team’s inactivity settings. Null if it was not auto-archived or has since been restored.

fields.name: autoClosedAt
fields.description: The time the issue was automatically closed after inactivity. Null if it has not been auto-closed or its status has changed since then.

fields.name: boardOrder
fields.description: The order of the item in its column on the board.
fields.deprecationReason: Will be removed in near future, please use `sortOrder` instead

fields.name: botActor
fields.description: The bot that created the issue, if applicable.

fields.name: branchName
fields.description: A suggested Git branch name based on the issue’s identifier and title and your branch naming preferences. This generates a name; it does not create a branch in a repository.

fields.name: canceledAt
fields.description: Time the issue entered a canceled or duplicate status. Cleared when it leaves those status types.

fields.name: children
fields.description: The issue’s direct sub-issues that you can access. Use each child’s children field to read deeper levels of the hierarchy; this connection does not flatten the full tree.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns results before this cursor. Pair with `last` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: filter
args.description: Filter returned subscribers.

args.name: first
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, starting after `after` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither `first` nor `last` is supplied. Cannot be combined with `last` or `before`.

args.name: includeArchived
args.description: Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources.

args.name: includeDisabled
args.description: Include disabled and suspended accounts. Defaults to false.

args.name: last
args.description: The maximum number of results to return, ending before `before` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with `first` or `after`.

args.name: orderBy
args.description: Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to `createdAt`. Results are newest first with `first` and oldest first with `last`; use the returned `endCursor` as `before` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom `sort` options on fields that support them.

types.name: IssueUpdateInput
types.description: The changes to make to an existing issue. Omit a field to keep its current value; each nullable field describes how to clear it. Lists such as labelIds and subscriberIds replace existing assignments, while addedLabelIds and removedLabelIds change only the specified labels.

inputFields.name: addedLabelIds
inputFields.description: Label UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

inputFields.name: addedReleaseIds
inputFields.description: Release UUIDs to add without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

inputFields.name: assigneeId
inputFields.description: UUID of the new assignee. Null unassigns the issue.

inputFields.name: autoClosedByParentClosing
inputFields.description: Record that this status change was caused by closing the parent issue. Requires stateId.

inputFields.name: cycleId
inputFields.description: UUID of a cycle in the issue’s team. Null removes the cycle, subject to the team’s automatic cycle assignment settings.

inputFields.name: delegateId
inputFields.description: The UUID of the agent to delegate work to. Changing the delegate can start an agent session; pass null to remove the delegate, or omit this field to keep the current one.

inputFields.name: description
inputFields.description: The replacement issue description in Markdown. Send an empty string to clear it, or omit this field to keep the current description. Null also leaves it unchanged. This replaces the full description rather than appending to it.

inputFields.name: dueDate
inputFields.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, without a time or time zone. Null clears it.

inputFields.name: estimate
inputFields.description: The numeric estimate, from 0 to 64, mapped to the nearest value in the team’s configured scale. Zero is accepted only when the team allows it. Pass null to clear the estimate, or omit it to keep the current value.

inputFields.name: inheritsSharedAccess
inputFields.description: Whether people with shared access to the parent also receive access to this issue. Setting true requires a parent issue. Omit this field to keep the current setting.

inputFields.name: labelIds
inputFields.description: Replacement list of label UUIDs. An empty list removes all labels. Cannot be combined with addedLabelIds or removedLabelIds.

inputFields.name: lastAppliedTemplateId
inputFields.description: UUID of the template to record as last applied. Does not apply template values. Pass null to clear the recorded template, or omit to keep it.

inputFields.name: parentId
inputFields.description: The UUID or identifier of the new parent issue, such as ENG-123. Pass null to make this a top-level issue, or omit it to keep the current parent. An issue cannot be its own ancestor.

inputFields.name: priority
inputFields.description: The priority of the issue. 0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Medium, 4 = Low.

inputFields.name: prioritySortOrder
inputFields.description: Position among issues with the same priority. Lower values appear first.

inputFields.name: projectId
inputFields.description: UUID or identifier of a project that includes the issue’s team. Null removes the project and milestone.

inputFields.name: projectMilestoneId
inputFields.description: UUID of a milestone in the issue’s project. Null removes the milestone.

inputFields.name: releaseIds
inputFields.description: Replacement list of release UUIDs. An empty list removes all release links. Cannot be combined with addedReleaseIds or removedReleaseIds.

inputFields.name: removedLabelIds
inputFields.description: Label UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with labelIds.

inputFields.name: removedReleaseIds
inputFields.description: Release UUIDs to remove without replacing the full list. Cannot be combined with releaseIds.

inputFields.name: slaType
inputFields.description: How to count time for the issue’s SLA: all for calendar days, or onlyBusinessDays for the team’s working days. Omit it to keep the current setting. Changing it recalculates the risk thresholds for an existing SLA.

inputFields.name: snoozedById
inputFields.description: The UUID of the user recorded as snoozing the issue. For API requests, Linear sets this from the acting user when snoozedUntilAt changes; you cannot change it independently.

inputFields.name: snoozedUntilAt
inputFields.description: The time until which to hide the issue from triage. Pass null to clear the snooze. Linear records the acting user as snoozedBy when a snooze is set.

inputFields.name: sortOrder
inputFields.description: Position in manually sorted lists. Lower values appear first.

inputFields.name: stateId
inputFields.description: UUID of a status in the issue’s team. A status change updates lifecycle times and may change cycle membership. Moving to the reserved duplicate status requires an existing duplicate relation; use issueRelationCreate to mark an issue as a duplicate.

inputFields.name: subIssueSortOrder
inputFields.description: Position among the parent’s sub-issues. Lower values appear first.

inputFields.name: subscriberIds
inputFields.description: The complete replacement list of subscriber UUIDs. An empty list removes the current subscribers; omitting the field keeps them. Assignee, delegate, or mention changes can add subscribers as part of the same update.

inputFields.name: teamId
inputFields.description: The UUID of the destination team. Moving an issue gives it a new team identifier and maps team-specific values, such as status and labels, to the destination team. Its UUID and previous identifiers are preserved.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: The replacement issue title. Omit to keep the current title; an empty string or null is not accepted.

inputFields.name: trashed
inputFields.description: The trash marker for an already archived issue. Set true to mark it as trashed, or null to remove that marker while keeping it archived. Use issueDelete to trash an active issue and issueUnarchive to restore it to normal issue lists.

types.name: JiraProjectMigrationErrorCode
types.description: Why one project of a Jira project migration failed its checks.

enumValues.name: duplicateProject
enumValues.description: The project appears more than once in the migration.

enumValues.name: importDeletionRunning
enumValues.description: A Jira import of the workspace is being deleted, or, for a project that only syncs, one of its own imports. Retry once it finishes.

enumValues.name: invalidJql
enumValues.description: The JQL filter does not parse.

enumValues.name: invalidOptions
enumValues.description: The project has no import and no sync, no team, a new team without an import, or not exactly one of an ID and a key.

enumValues.name: jiraAuthFailed
enumValues.description: Linear cannot sign in to Jira with the site's connection.

enumValues.name: jiraRateLimited
enumValues.description: Jira rate limited the checks. Retry later.

enumValues.name: jiraUnavailable
enumValues.description: Jira did not answer the checks, or answered with something they cannot read. Retry later.

enumValues.name: legacySyncDirection
enumValues.description: The legacy one-way sync was asked for. Only links that already use it keep it.

enumValues.name: missingCreateIssuesPermission
enumValues.description: Two-way sync was asked for, and the site's connection lacks Create Issues on the project.

enumValues.name: missingInvitePermission
enumValues.description: Inviting users was asked for without the permission to invite users.

enumValues.name: missingJiraAccess
enumValues.description: The user's own Jira account cannot access the project, or cannot sign in to Jira.

enumValues.name: missingTeamCreationPermission
enumValues.description: A new team was asked for without the team creation permission.

enumValues.name: missingWebhookPermission
enumValues.description: The site's connection lacks the global ADMINISTER permission, which Linear needs to create the project's webhook.

enumValues.name: noMatchingIssues
enumValues.description: The import would read no issues.

enumValues.name: projectAlreadySyncing
enumValues.description: Sync was asked for a project that already syncs. A project that only syncs, and already syncs with the same team in the same direction, counts as started instead.

enumValues.name: projectBeingImported
enumValues.description: The project has a queued import, or a running one that changed in the last 24 hours. An import by the same user with the same choices counts as started instead.

enumValues.name: projectChanged
enumValues.description: The project was already migrating as asked when the checks began, but its import completed or its link changed before the migration could start. Send the project again.

enumValues.name: projectNotFound
enumValues.description: The ID or key is not in the site's project list.

enumValues.name: projectNotReadable
enumValues.description: The site's connection cannot read the project.

enumValues.name: projectSyncsWithAnotherTeam
enumValues.description: An import was asked into a team other than the one the project syncs with.

enumValues.name: teamInheritsWorkflowStatuses
enumValues.description: The team inherits its parent's workflow statuses, which an import would need to create.

enumValues.name: teamNotAccessible
enumValues.description: The user cannot access the team.

enumValues.name: teamNotFound
enumValues.description: The team does not exist or is archived.

enumValues.name: teamQuotaExceeded
enumValues.description: The project's new team would exceed the workspace's team limit. The projects that pass their other checks take the room left under the limit in input order.

fields.name: agentActivityCreate
fields.description: Publishes an activity to your agent’s session and updates its lifecycle. Thoughts and actions report ongoing work; a response completes the turn unless it has the continue signal, an elicitation waits for user input, and an error records a failed turn. The session must be unarchived and owned by the authenticated app user. Use the agent app’s OAuth or workload identity token; personal API keys cannot publish agent activities.

Supply the UUID of an unarchived root comment; replies and threads that already have a session are rejected. The caller must have access to the issue. Use the returned session ID when publishing activities.

fields.description: Link a Salesforce case to an issue. Requires a connected Salesforce integration and a valid case URL.

args.name: createAsUser
args.description: Display name credited with creating the attachment. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

args.name: displayIconUrl
args.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional attachment ID that may be provided through the API.

args.name: issueId
args.description: The issue for which to link the Salesforce case. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

args.name: title
args.description: The title to use for the attachment.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL of the Salesforce case to link.

fields.name: attachmentLinkSlack
fields.description: Link an existing Slack message to an issue. This creates a rich attachment using the workspace's Slack integration.

args.name: createAsUser
args.description: Display name credited with creating the attachment. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

args.name: displayIconUrl
args.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional attachment ID that may be provided through the API.

args.name: issueId
args.description: The issue to which to link the Slack message. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

args.name: syncToCommentThread
args.description: Sync the Slack thread with issue comments and import existing replies. Defaults to false; the thread cannot already be synced elsewhere.

args.name: title
args.description: The title to use for the attachment.

args.name: url
args.description: The Slack message URL for the message to link.

fields.name: attachmentLinkURL
fields.description: Links a URL to an issue and, when recognized, uses the workspace’s matching integration to fetch richer details. Supported integrations can add behaviors such as status updates. If no matching integration can enrich the link, Linear creates a basic URL attachment.

args.name: createAsUser
args.description: Display name credited with creating the attachment. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

args.name: displayIconUrl
args.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

args.name: id
args.description: The id for the attachment.

args.name: issueId
args.description: The issue for which to link the url. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

args.name: title
args.description: The title to use for the attachment.

args.name: url
args.description: The url to link.

fields.name: attachmentLinkZendesk
fields.description: Link a Zendesk ticket to an issue. Requires a connected Zendesk integration.

args.name: createAsUser
args.description: Display name credited with creating the attachment. Available only to OAuth applications using actor=app.

args.name: displayIconUrl
args.description: Avatar URL for createAsUser. Requires createAsUser and an OAuth application using actor=app.

args.name: id
args.description: Optional attachment ID that may be provided through the API.

args.name: issueId
args.description: The issue for which to link the Zendesk ticket. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., 'LIN-123').

args.name: ticketId
args.description: The Zendesk ticket ID to link.

args.name: title
args.description: The title to use for the attachment.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL of the Zendesk ticket to link.

fields.name: attachmentSyncToSlack
fields.description: Sync an existing Slack attachment with an issue comment thread and import existing replies. Requires a connected Slack integration whose bot can post in the channel; the Slack thread cannot already be synced elsewhere.

args.name: id
args.description: The ID of the Slack attachment to begin syncing.

fields.name: attachmentUpdate
fields.description: Updates an existing attachment’s title, subtitle, metadata, or icon. title is required even when changing another field, and metadata replaces the full stored object. This mutation does not move the attachment or change its URL.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the attachment to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial attachment object to update the attachment with.

fields.name: commentCreate
fields.description: Creates a comment on one resource, or a reply when parentId is supplied. You must be allowed to comment on that resource. For issue comments, the author is subscribed to the issue unless doNotSubscribeToIssue is true.

args.name: input
args.description: The comment object to create.

fields.name: commentDelete
fields.description: Deletes a comment and, for a root comment, its replies. You must be allowed to delete the comment and comment on its resource. Deleting a reply selected as the resolution reopens the parent thread.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the comment to delete.

fields.name: commentResolve
fields.description: Marks a root comment’s thread as resolved by you. You may select one of its replies as resolvingCommentId, or resolve the thread without a specific reply. Pass the root comment ID, even when the discussion ended in a reply.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the comment to resolve.

args.name: resolvingCommentId
args.description: The identifier of the child comment that resolves the thread. If not provided, the thread is resolved without a specific resolving comment.

fields.name: commentUnresolve
fields.description: Reopens a resolved thread and clears its resolution time, resolving user, and selected resolving reply. Pass the root comment ID. An already unresolved thread is returned unchanged.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the comment to unresolve.

fields.name: commentUpdate
fields.description: Replaces a comment’s Markdown body and records an edit time. Content edits are restricted to an authorized author or acting user; comments originating in synced Slack messages or Intercom cannot be edited here. Omit body to keep the existing message.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the comment to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial comment object to update the comment with.

args.name: skipEditedAt
args.description: [INTERNAL] Flag to prevent setting editedAt when updating bodyData (used for background uploads).

fields.name: contactCreate
fields.description: Submits a message to Linear support on behalf of the authenticated user. Delivery happens after the request succeeds.

args.name: input
args.description: The contact entry to create.

fields.name: createCsvExportReport
fields.description: Queues a workspace CSV export and emails the requesting user a download link when it is ready. Success confirms scheduling, not completion. Private and restricted teams are excluded unless explicitly selected by their UUIDs. Requires workspace export permission, which permits selecting eligible teams even when the requester is not a member.

args.name: includePrivateTeamIds
args.description: UUIDs of private teams to include in the export. Omit or use an empty list to exclude private teams. Restricted teams are selected separately.

args.name: includeRestrictedTeamIds
args.description: UUIDs of restricted teams to include in the export. An empty list excludes restricted teams. Omission falls back to the deprecated includeProtectedTeamIds list, or excludes them if neither list is provided.

fields.name: createInitiativeUpdateReminder
fields.description: Create a notification to remind a user about an initiative update.

args.name: initiativeId
args.description: The identifier of the initiative to remind about.

args.name: userId
args.description: The user identifier to whom the notification will be sent. By default, it is set to the initiative owner.

fields.name: createProjectUpdateReminder
fields.description: Create a notification to remind a user about a project update.

args.name: projectId
args.description: The identifier of the project to remind about.

args.name: userId
args.description: The user identifier to whom the notification will be sent. By default, it is set to the project lead.

fields.name: customViewCreate
fields.description: Creates a saved view owned by you. Choose an issue, project, initiative, or update filter and set shared if others in its scope should use it. Display settings can be saved separately with viewPreferencesCreate.

args.name: input
args.description: The properties of the custom view to create.

fields.name: customViewDelete
fields.description: Deletes a saved view without deleting the items it displayed. Only workspace members can delete views shared with the whole workspace; deleting a view used in a pinned tab also requires permission to edit that tab. Use customViewHasSubscribers to check whether other people receive notifications from the view.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the custom view to delete.

fields.name: customViewUpdate
fields.description: Updates a saved view’s metadata, scope, or filter configuration. Omitted fields are unchanged. Only workspace members can change views shared with the whole workspace; editing a view used in a pinned tab also requires permission to edit that tab.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the custom view to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The properties of the custom view to update.

fields.name: customerCreate
fields.description: Creates a customer when the Customers feature is available and enabled in the workspace. Business domains and external IDs must not belong to another customer, including archived customers. If no status is supplied, the first customer status by position is used.

args.name: input
args.description: The customer to create.

fields.name: customerDelete
fields.description: Permanently deletes a customer, including an archived customer. Use customerMerge when you want to preserve its requests by transferring them to another customer.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer to delete.

fields.name: customerMerge
fields.description: Merges two customers by transferring all needs from the source customer to the target customer. The source customer is archived after the merge. Domains, external IDs, and metadata are combined on the target customer.

args.name: sourceCustomerId
args.description: The ID of the source customer to merge. All needs from this customer will be transferred to the target, and this customer will be archived.

args.name: targetCustomerId
args.description: The ID of the target customer to merge into. This customer will receive all needs from the source customer and retain its own.

fields.name: customerNeedArchive
fields.description: Archives a customer need so it can be removed from active request lists without permanently deleting it. Use customerNeedUnarchive to restore the saved need.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer need to archive.

fields.name: customerNeedCreate
fields.description: Records a customer request against an issue. Provide input.issueId and optionally identify the customer, add Markdown feedback, or link a source attachment. Multiple needs can be recorded for the same customer and issue.

args.name: input
args.description: The customer need to create.

fields.name: customerNeedCreateFromAttachment
fields.description: Creates a customer need from an existing issue attachment. If that attachment already has an archived need, the need is restored and follows the attachment’s current issue. An existing active need is not duplicated.

args.name: input
args.description: The customer need to create.

fields.name: customerNeedDelete
fields.description: Permanently deletes a customer need. By default, its associated issue or project attachment is also deleted. Set keepAttachment to true to retain that source attachment; the linked issue or project is kept.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer need to delete.

args.name: keepAttachment
args.description: Whether to keep the attachment associated with the customer need.

fields.name: customerNeedUnarchive
fields.description: Restores an archived customer need. The need must currently be archived; its saved feedback and associations are kept.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer need to unarchive.

fields.name: customerNeedUpdate
fields.description: Updates a customer request, including its feedback, customer, priority, or issue association. Only manually added source attachments can be replaced or removed. Use clearAttachment to remove such a source; moving the request to another issue also moves its source attachment.

args.name: clearAttachment
args.description: Whether to remove the manually added source attachment. Sources managed by an integration cannot be removed this way. A different, nonempty attachmentUrl takes precedence.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer need to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The properties of the customer need to update.

fields.name: customerStatusCreate
fields.description: Creates a workspace customer status. Requires permission to manage customer settings and rejects a name or display name already used by another active status.

args.name: input
args.description: The CustomerStatus object to create.

fields.name: customerStatusDelete
fields.description: Deletes a customer status. Cannot delete the last remaining status in a workspace, and the status must not be in use by any customers.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer status to delete.

fields.name: customerStatusUpdate
fields.description: Updates a workspace customer status. Requires permission to manage customer settings. Customers using the status retain their association with it.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer status to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial CustomerStatus object to update the CustomerStatus with.

fields.name: customerTierCreate
fields.description: Creates a workspace customer tier. Requires permission to manage customer settings and rejects a name or display name already used by another active tier.

args.name: input
args.description: The CustomerTier object to create.

fields.name: customerTierDelete
fields.description: Deletes a customer tier. The tier must not be in use by any customers.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer tier to delete.

fields.name: customerTierUpdate
fields.description: Updates a workspace customer tier. Requires permission to manage customer settings. Customers using the tier retain their association with it.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer tier to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial CustomerTier object to update the CustomerTier with.

fields.name: customerUnsync
fields.description: Disconnects a customer from its configured data source integration so the integration no longer updates it. External IDs belonging to that source are cleared. Requires permission to manage workspace customer settings.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer to unsync.

fields.name: customerUpdate
fields.description: Updates the supplied customer fields, leaving omitted fields unchanged. For a customer managed by an integration, only fields that are editable in Linear are applied; managed fields are ignored. The request fails if none of the supplied fields are editable.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the customer to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The properties of the customer to update.

fields.name: customerUpsert
fields.description: Finds a customer using the supplied UUID, external ID, Slack channel, or domains, and updates it; otherwise creates one. A name is required when no customer matches. Unlike customerUpdate, this operation can override integration-managed fields, and a tierName can create a new customer tier.

args.name: input
args.description: The customer to create.

fields.name: cycleArchive
fields.description: Archives a cycle and removes its current issues from it. The issues themselves are not archived. An inherited cycle must be managed through its parent team.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the cycle to archive.

fields.name: cycleCreate
fields.description: Unsupported. This mutation always returns an error; cycles are generated from the team’s cycle settings.

args.name: input
args.description: The cycle object to create.

fields.name: cycleShiftAll
fields.description: Shifts an upcoming cycle and every later cycle in the team by the same number of days. Local times are preserved in the team’s time zone, and the team’s cycle start day is updated. Use this when moving the schedule as a whole; it requires permission to manage the team.

args.name: input
args.description: The shift parameters specifying which cycle to start from and how many days to shift.

fields.name: cycleStartUpcomingCycleToday
fields.description: Starts the upcoming cycle as of midnight today. Completes the previous cycle if it has not yet ended. Only the next upcoming (not yet started) cycle for the team can be started.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the cycle to start as of midnight today. Must be the upcoming cycle.

fields.name: cycleUpdate
fields.description: Updates a cycle’s name, description, or schedule and returns the resulting cycle. Date changes can shorten adjacent cycles to prevent overlap. You cannot change an active cycle’s start or a completed cycle’s dates, or edit inherited cycles directly.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the cycle to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial cycle object to update the cycle with.

fields.name: documentCreate
fields.description: Creates a document in a project, issue, or release, with optional initial Markdown content. The returned document includes its assigned UUID and metadata; select content to read the resulting body.

args.name: input
args.description: The document to create.

fields.name: documentDelete
fields.description: Moves a document to the trash and archives it, including the sub-documents covered by its archive cascade. It is not permanently removed by this mutation. You must be allowed to manage the document; use documentUnarchive to restore it.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the document to delete.

args.name: ifParentDocumentId
args.description: [Internal] Only trash the document if it is still a sub-document of this document. Otherwise the mutation fails and the document is left unchanged.

fields.name: documentUnarchive
fields.description: Restores a trashed document and its eligible sub-documents. You must be allowed to manage the restored documents. If the containing resource is archived, restore that resource first.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the document to restore.

fields.name: documentUpdate
fields.description: Updates a document’s metadata or replaces its Markdown body. You must have edit access to the document. Supplying a different container moves the document there, which can affect access; omitted fields are left unchanged.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the document to update. Also the identifier from the URL is accepted.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial document object to update the document with.

fields.name: documentUpdateWorkspaceAccess
fields.description: [Internal] Changes what people outside a document's teams can do with a document in a public team or in a project with a public team: edit, comment, or view. It can't be above the document's general access. Only the owner of the document, an owner of one of its teams, or a workspace admin can change it. Comment and view need an owner who can access the document.

args.name: applyToSubDocuments
args.description: Whether to also change the sub-documents whose levels equal the document's levels before the change. Sub-documents with other levels, without an owner who can access them, or that the user cannot loosen keep their level.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the document.

args.name: previousWorkspaceAccess
args.description: The workspace access level of this document when the change was confirmed. When given, the change fails if the document has another level now.

args.name: workspaceAccess
args.description: The new workspace access level: edit, comment, or view.

fields.name: emailIntakeAddressCreate
fields.description: Creates an address that accepts email for one team or issue template. For team and template types, an existing active address for that destination is returned instead of creating another. Use the returned emailAddress as the forwarding destination in your mail provider. Asks creation requires the appropriate plan and integration management permission; team and template addresses require permission to manage their destination. Form templates cannot be used for template intake.

args.name: input
args.description: The email intake address object to create.

fields.name: emailIntakeAddressDelete
fields.description: Deletes an email intake address object.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the email intake address to delete.

fields.name: emailIntakeAddressRefreshSesDomainStatus
fields.description: Requests a check of the intake address’s custom sending domain after you update its DNS records. The check runs asynchronously: success means a check was requested, not that the domain passed verification. Query sesDomainIdentity.canSendFromCustomDomain and dnsRecords for the result. Returns success=false when no custom domain is configured or the domain is already fully verified.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the email intake address to refresh the domain status for.

fields.name: emailIntakeAddressRotate
fields.description: Generates a new email address for an existing team or template intake configuration. The old address no longer routes incoming mail, so update any forwarding rules or places where you published it. The intake record and its settings are retained. Asks and Asks web addresses do not support rotation through this mutation.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the email intake address.

fields.name: emailIntakeAddressUpdate
fields.description: Updates an existing email intake address.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the email intake address.

args.name: input
args.description: The properties of the email intake address to update.

fields.name: emailTokenUserAccountAuth
fields.description: Completes email sign-in using the emailed token and the same clientAuthCode sent with emailUserAccountAuthChallenge. Successful authentication consumes the client binding and sets a session cookie. Use the returned memberships and available or locked workspaces to continue into a workspace; the deprecated token field is not populated. An expired token or a code from a different client cannot complete this flow.

args.name: input
args.description: The data used for token authentication.

fields.name: emailUnsubscribe
fields.description: Unsubscribes a user from the selected email category using the user ID and token from a Linear email. No sign-in is required because the token authorizes the change. An invalid token returns success=false; other email categories and notification channels are unchanged.

args.name: input
args.description: Unsubscription details.

fields.name: emailUserAccountAuthChallenge
fields.description: Starts email sign-in and sends a one-time token to the supplied address. Generate and retain a clientAuthCode UUID, then pass it with the emailed token to emailTokenUserAccountAuth within ten minutes. Requesting another challenge replaces the stored client binding for that email. When login challenge verification is enabled, challengeResponse is also required. Success confirms the challenge was accepted; email delivery may finish in the background.

args.name: input
args.description: The data used for email authentication.

fields.name: emojiCreate
fields.description: Creates a custom emoji from an image already uploaded to Linear. Its name must be unique in the workspace. The current user is recorded as the creator, and the source is user.

args.name: input
args.description: The emoji object to create.

fields.name: emojiDelete
fields.description: Deletes an emoji.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the emoji to delete.

fields.name: entityExternalLinkCreate
fields.description: Adds an external resource to an initiative, project, or release the caller can access and write to. Provide exactly one parent, a destination URL, and the label to show in Linear. Omit sortOrder to place the link last among the parent’s resources. This stores a reference to the URL; it does not upload or copy the destination content.

args.name: input
args.description: The entity link object to create.

fields.name: entityExternalLinkDelete
fields.description: Removes a resource link from Linear and clears any team pins that refer to it. The external URL’s content is unchanged. The caller must have access to the link’s parent scope; archived links can also be deleted.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the entity link to delete.

fields.name: entityExternalLinkUpdate
fields.description: Changes an unarchived resource link’s URL, display label, or position within its parent’s resources. Omitted fields remain unchanged, and the parent cannot be changed. The link must be writable and within the caller’s permitted scope.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the entity link to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The entity link object to update.

fields.name: favoriteCreate
fields.description: Creates a sidebar favorite for the authenticated user. If it already exists, updates its position and supplied folder instead.

args.name: input
args.description: The favorite object to create.

fields.name: favoriteDelete
fields.description: Removes a favorite from your sidebar. Deleting a custom folder also removes the favorites inside it; the bookmarked entities are unaffected. The mutation succeeds if the favorite no longer exists.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the favorite reference to delete.

fields.name: favoriteUpdate
fields.description: Changes the position, parent folder, or name of one of your favorites. Omitted fields stay unchanged. The target entity cannot be changed, and predefined live folders cannot be renamed.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the favorite to update.

args.name: input
args.description: A partial favorite object to update the favorite with.

fields.name: fileUpload
fields.description: Prepares a file upload and returns a signed destination. Upload the raw bytes with HTTP PUT to uploadFile.uploadUrl, using its headers and the supplied Content-Type; start the request within one minute and send exactly size bytes. Once the PUT succeeds, reference uploadFile.assetUrl in an issue description, comment, or attachment. This mutation does not create that reference for you. Workspace file-type restrictions and plan upload limits apply.

args.name: contentType
args.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

args.name: filename
args.description: Filename of the uploaded file.

args.name: makePublic
args.description: Whether anyone with the asset URL can view the uploaded image without authenticating. Omit or set false for a private upload. Only non-SVG images can be public; other file types are rejected when this is true.

args.name: metaData
args.description: Optional metadata encoded as a JSON string, such as {"issueId":"..."} or {"commentId":"..."}. These references record upload context; they do not insert the file into that issue or comment. You still need to use assetUrl when creating or updating the content.

args.name: size
args.description: Exact file size in bytes. The upload request must match this size.

fields.name: fileUploadDangerouslyDelete
fields.description: Permanently delete an uploaded file by asset URL. This should be used as a last resort and will break comments and documents that reference the asset.

args.name: assetUrl
args.description: The asset URL of the uploaded file to delete.

fields.name: gitAutomationStateCreate
fields.description: Creates a rule that maps a Git event to an issue status for a team. Requires permission to manage that team. Rules cannot be created for retired teams.

args.name: input
args.description: The automation state to create.

fields.name: gitAutomationStateDelete
fields.description: Permanently deletes a Git automation rule. Requires permission to manage its team. Removing a branch-specific rule allows the team’s default for that event to apply again.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the automation state to delete.

fields.name: gitAutomationStateUpdate
fields.description: Updates the status, branch scope, or event of an existing rule. Requires permission to manage its team, and the team must not be retired. Omitted fields keep their values.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the state to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The state to update.

fields.name: gitAutomationTargetBranchCreate
fields.description: Creates a team’s target-branch pattern for Git automation. Add automation rules that reference the returned definition to choose the status changes. Requires team-management permission and an active, non-retired team.

args.name: input
args.description: The Git target branch automation to create.

fields.name: gitAutomationTargetBranchDelete
fields.description: Deletes a target-branch definition and its associated automation rules. Future matching events use any remaining applicable rules, including team defaults. Requires team-management permission.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the target branch definition to delete.

fields.name: gitAutomationTargetBranchUpdate
fields.description: Changes the pattern or matching mode used by every automation rule linked to this definition. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Requires team-management permission; definitions in retired teams cannot be updated.

args.name: id
args.description: The identifier of the Git target branch automation to update.

args.name: input
args.description: The updates.

fields.name: googleUserAccountAuth
fields.description: Exchanges a Google OAuth code, sets the authentication cookie, and returns workspace access details. May create an account unless disallowSignup is true.

args.name: input
args.description: The data used for Google authentication.

fields.name: imageUploadFromUrl
fields.description: Copies an image from an external URL into Linear’s private upload storage. The URL must let Linear download the image directly; an HTML page containing the image is not accepted. On success, the returned URL refers to the copied image and can be used in Linear content. Unlike fileUpload, this mutation performs the download and upload for you.

args.name: url
args.description: URL of the file to be uploaded to Linear.

fields.name: importFileUpload
fields.description: Prepares a file in Linear’s import storage. Upload the raw bytes with HTTP PUT to the returned uploadUrl, using all returned headers and the matching Content-Type. The upload must start within one minute and contain exactly the declared number of bytes. Success prepares the destination; it does not upload the bytes or start an import.

args.name: contentType
args.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

args.name: filename
